# Review: vladdoster/dotfiles agent-docs

**Sampled:** 11 of 17 docs, 15 claims spot-checked. One independent Opus review round; fixes applied and `verify` re-run.

## Blocking

None.

## Should fix (all fixed after review)

- reference/style: function-file count corrected to 66 of 66 for `emulate -L zsh`; rules labelled Enforced without a running check relabelled Team; Established rules with counterexamples dropped or narrowed; stray `level` removed.
- areas/zsh: line citations into functions/AGENTS.md corrected; "every function has a completion" qualified for the exempt helper; literal functions.zwc restored.
- areas/cli-tools: PIP citation corrected to 00-env.zsh:34-36; Vim guard description made consistent.
- areas/desktop: Brewfile sentence now names wezterm and tmux.
- Garbled phrases from a mechanical edit pass fixed in style, desktop, everyday-utilities, flow and startup.
- START-HERE: L0 diagram added.
- COMMON-TASKS: overlapping triggers deduplicated so each task has one owner doc.
- components/zsh/startup: alias groups from 01-alias.zsh now covered.

## Notes

- The single derived flow (add-zsh-function) rests on PRs 58, 59 and 61, which are consecutive feat(zsh) PRs; their file sets overlap and PR 60 is the counterexample. Reported as derived with rationale.
- Two entry points (dkr:336, wezterm::_pane:12) land on `emulate -L zsh` lines.
- cli-tools and desktop read partly as setting-by-setting listings; acceptable for config files.

## Routing test

| Task | Routed to | Landed usefully |
|---|---|---|
| Add a new shell alias | components/zsh/startup -> 01-alias.zsh:60-79 | yes after alias groups were added |
| Fix tmux copy-mode clipboard on macOS | areas/desktop -> tmux.conf:42-43 | yes |
| Change the git pager | areas/cli-tools -> git/.config/git/config:11-16 | yes |
| Install a release binary through zinit | components/zsh/startup -> 05-zinit.zsh:56-60 | yes |
| Add a check to the e2e installer test | areas/bootstrap -> .github/tests/e2e.zsh:67-87 | yes |

| kitty/.config/kitty/kitty.conf | desktop | yes |

| zsh/.config/zsh/completions/ | five owners | yes |
| python/.config/ | cli-tools, style | yes |
| bin/.local/bin/ | cli-tools | yes |
